D/ IMP TITVS CAES VESPASIAN AVG PM ; R/ TR P IX IMP XV COS VIII P P

Westbury-sub-Mendip hoard. Obverse legend IMP TITVS CAES VESPASIAN AVG PM. Reverse legend TR P IX IMP XV COS VIII P P. Rome AD 80. RIC 22a. Contents: 189 silver denarii: Antony 32-31 BC, 10; Nero AD 54-68, 2; Galba AD 68-9, 1; Otho AD 69, 1; Vitellius AD 69, 2; Vespasian AD 69-79, 18; Titus Caesar, 3; Domitian Caesar, 1; Titus AD 79-81, 4; Domitian Caesar, 2; Domitian AD 81-96, 8; Nerva AD 96-8,…
